Who we are and what we do Strategic
report
Standard Chartered Bank Kenya Limited (‘the Company’, ‘the Bank’
or 'Standard Chartered') is a leading international cross-border bank
and is Kenya’s largest international bank.
We are a global bank connecting corporate, institutional and
affluent clients to a network that offers unique access to sustainable
growth opportunities across Asia, Africa and the Middle East.
Our strategy is designed to deliver our purpose: to drive commerce
and prosperity through our unique diversity. This is underpinned by
our brand promise, here for good.
